limitations: First real disposable epoch-store/sharing fixture only. No production store, enrollment, registry, service or ACL writes.
Fifteen native C# files and supervisor are unchanged from the accepted 19445 source repair. No managed suite reruns.
Fresh synthetic records embed current run/nonce and observed file identities. SID and approval fields remain synthetic metadata.
Parent creates four files/four directories and then closes all its fixture streams before one native child.
Sharing challenge opens with write access but never writes; only exact c0000043 while held and success after release pass.
Gate closes last among seven owner handles. Separate witness root closes after the challenge; no gate handoff.
No forced-pending or crash/durability challenge. Unexpected pending, timeout, kill or unknown exit are ERROR, not PASS.
Child reports repeated raw security/metadata checks, not P00 root provenance, effective access or continuous namespace proof.
CPython 3.12.10 lstat identities are point-in-time expectations, not an adversarial path-safety or enrollment proof.
No parent-side ACL snapshot or alternate-data-stream enumeration is claimed. Exact inventory covers ordinary directory entries.
No guarantee against kernel/process-start stalls. The watchdog/stop requests do not prove exit until confirmed.
Path/hash/Framework checks are integrity observations, not runtime attestation or proof against same-user races.
Any error preserves remaining new work and create-once report. Old ERROR/build identities are not opened or modified.
Repeat guard is not a concurrency lock. A crash may leave a partial reserved report; preserve it, no automatic retry.
